title: Time Series Change Point Detection with Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.13295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel general Gaussian process framework for change point detection in time series. A change is defined as an alteration of the hyperparameters of the Gaussian process prior. We formulate the problem in the context of statistical hypothesis testing and demonstrate its performance over both offline and online multiple change points detection. The approach provides theoretical guaranties of its performance. An important advantage of the developed framework is that it does not need a detailed specification of the time series function before and after a change. The hyperparameter values are learned from the data. Comprehensive evaluation of the proposed framework is provided both on synthetic and real data and its efficiency is demonstrated.

translated_title: 基于高斯过程的时间序列变点检测
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的通用高斯过程框架，用于时间序列中的变点检测。在该框架中，变化被定义为高斯过程先验超参数的改变。我们将该问题置于统计假设检验的背景下进行建模，并展示了该方法在离线和在线多变点检测任务中的性能。该方法为其性能提供了理论保证。所开发框架的一个重要优势在于，它无需在变化发生前对时间序列函数进行详细设定，超参数的值可以从数据中学习得到。本文在合成数据和真实数据上对该框架进行了全面评估，并验证了其有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯过程的通用变点检测框架，将变化定义为高斯过程先验超参数的改变，具有理论性能保证，且无需预先指定变化前后的时间序列函数形式，超参数可从数据中自动学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel general Gaussian process framework for time series change point detection, defining changes as alterations of GP prior hyperparameters, with theoretical performance guarantees and no need for pre-specifying time series functions before and after a change.
